(49)he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/rnal 'byor lam gyi nyi ma ni/hūm̐/rang byung rig pa chos sku stong pa nyid/rig gdangs snying rje chen po'i rol pa lalas/rgya

tei:div.tei:p: he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ rnal 'byor lam gyi nyi ma ni/ hūm̐/ rang byung rig pa chos sku stong pa nyid/ rig gdangs snying rje chen po'i rol pa lalas/ rgyu yi yi ge rnam pa hūm̐ mthing nyid/ skad cig yongs gyur 'bras bu dpal chen po/ rdo rje gzhon nu zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ mthing nag 'bar ba cir yang (50)'char ba'i sku/ gar gyi nyams dgu dpal gyi chas bcu spras/ g.yas gnyis rdo rje rtse dgu lnga dang*/ me dpung 'bar ba kha ṭaṃ g.yon gnyis phyag mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu 'dril zhing 'debs/ rgyas 'debs sngon med kha ṭaṃ dung dmar stobs/ rgyal ba ma lus 'dus pa'i yi ge gsum/ spro bsdus bdag nyid sku gsung thugs rgyas gdab/ thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje sems/ de yi thugs kar ting (51)(52)'jin sems dpa'i mthar/ rtsa ba'i sngags phreng 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis/ 'phro 'dus don byas rang byung don gyi lha/ gnyug ma'i lha tshogs 'du 'bral med par blta/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bhig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ phrin las ngor mkhan ming sogs//
